subject: Request: an approved novena to St. Pio for a free Catholic prayer app / Richiesta di autorizzazione
body:
Dear Friars of San Giovanni Rotondo,

North Boutique Studios Ltd. publishes John 1:1, a free Catholic Bible and prayer app for iPhone, iPad and
Android. We want every prayer in the app to come from an approved source. We would like to include a novena to
Saint Pio of Pietrelcina, and we ask:

1. Which English novena to St. Pio do the Capuchin Friars publish or recommend (for example the Efficacious
   Novena to the Sacred Heart of Jesus that Padre Pio prayed every day, or a novena to St. Pio himself)?
2. May we include that text in the app, unchanged, with your credit line and a link to the Foundation?

- Use: a nine-day novena guide, available offline, free. The app has no ads and no account. One optional
  purchase unlocks a library of Church Fathers; the novena is not part of it.
- Platforms and markets: iOS and Android, worldwide, English (Italian later if you wish).
- Audience: about 120 new downloads every 90 days and about 330 existing users (October 2026).
- Organisation: North Boutique Studios Ltd., 846 Roulston St, London, ON N6H 0E4, Canada.

We would be grateful for your permission and any terms or offering you ask for.
